reasoning: The divergence is real and the legacy path really does route through it, but it is latent in almost every configuration, so I keep it low and narrow the scope. Verified: src/KOKKOS/comm_kokkos.cpp:1866-1896 grow_send_kokkos does 'maxsend = static_cast<int>(BUFFACTOR * n); int maxsend_border = (maxsend+Comm::BUFEXTRA)/atomKK->avecKK->size_border;' and then allocates maxsend_border rows of size_border, i.e. at most maxsend + 1024 doubles (and up to size_border-1 fewer, because of the truncating division). CommBrick::grow_send (src/comm_brick.cpp:1425-1438) allocates 'maxsend+bufextra' in all three flag branches, and src/comm.cpp:266-273 Comm::init_exchange sets 'maxexchange = maxexchange_atom + maxexchange_fix; bufextra = maxexchange + BUFEXTRA;' (BUFEXTRA = 1024, src/comm.h:34). The headroom is needed because CommBrick::exchange() tests 'if (nsend > maxsend) grow_send(nsend,1);' BEFORE packing one atom of up to maxexchange doubles at buf_send[nsend]. The legacy path does reach the KOKKOS allocator: src/KOKKOS/comm_kokkos.h:98 declares 'void grow_send(int, int) override;' and comm_kokkos.cpp:1846-1849 is 'void CommKokkos::grow_send(int n, int flag) { grow_send_kokkos(n,flag,Host); }', and CommKokkos::exchange() (1032-1043) falls through to CommBrick::exchange() whenever exchange_comm_legacy is set. What makes it latent: maxexchange_atom is 0 for every atom style except body (grep over src/*/atom_vec*.cpp shows only atom_vec_body.cpp:135 and the hybrid sum), because AtomVec only sets it when the size exceeds BUFEXTRA, and maxexchange_fix is 0 unless a fix sets it (fix neigh/history, fix store/atom, fix store/state, fix qtb/qbmsst, GRANSURF). So bufextra == BUFEXTRA in the common case and the two agree; the overflow needs maxexchange to exceed ~1024 minus the truncation remainder. The KOKKOS device exchange path is not affected because pack_exchange_kokkos re-grows k_buf_send itself (see the comment at comm_kokkos.cpp:1299).
fix: In src/KOKKOS/comm_kokkos.cpp:1870 use the member instead of the constant and round up: 'int maxsend_border = (maxsend + bufextra + atomKK->avecKK->size_border - 1)/atomKK->avecKK->size_border;'. Comm::bufextra is a protected member kept current by Comm::init_exchange(), so it is directly accessible here. Apply the same rounding to grow_recv_kokkos line 1906 for consistency (that one needs no bufextra: CommBrick::grow_recv allocates only maxrecv).
